name: dynatrace
description: Kanban control tower for Dynatrace problems, services, and applications — with agentic smart ranking. Read-only, powered by dtctl.
author: Simone Pomata
highlights: Kanban control tower for Dynatrace problems, services, and applications
Agentic smart ranking triages active problems best-first
Read-only and safe: powered by dtctl, never mutates Dynatrace state
Works instantly in demo mode with no credentials required

crons.name: dynatrace-smart-rank
crons.message: Smart-rank the Dynatrace app Kanban board. Steps: (1) Find the backend port: read the JSON file at ${KIROCREW_HOME:-~/.kiro/crew}/apps/dynatrace/data/backend.json and take its "port" field. If the file is missing or unreadable, finish silently (the backend isn't running). (2) Get the board: GET http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/board?view=problems&window=7d (local backend, no auth needed). If the request fails to connect, finish silently - the backend isn't running or the port is stale. (3) If the response has demo:true, or the columns new/ongoing/maintenance contain zero cards in total, finish silently - do not write a ranking and do not notify anyone. (4) Otherwise rank ONLY the cards from the new, ongoing, and maintenance columns, best-first, by triage urgency. Use your judgment: category weight (AVAILABILITY > ERROR > RESOURCE_CONTENTION > SLOWDOWN), blast radius (affected_count), whether a root cause is identified, problem age, recurrence (same title reappearing), and anything you know from memory about this user's environment and priorities. (5) POST the ranking to http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/rank with JSON body {"view":"problems","order":[<display_id best-first>...],"rationales":{<display_id>:"<one short sentence why this position>"}}. (6) Complete silently: no user notification, no Slack, minimal output.
